name: Electrocute consumes Electrocutioner
contract: Electrocutioner (804592) resets Electrocute and makes the next one usable regardless of the target's health. Its Spell.dbc record has no proc flags or charges (ProcFlags 0, ProcCharges 0, 15 s duration), so nothing removed it when Electrocute was cast: the buff kept Electrocute highlighted for its whole duration while the 6 s category cooldown (978) Electrocute had just started ran underneath it. A player Electrocute (801844) cast on a full-health target, possible only through the buff's SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE, must remove the buff. The actor lacks the Electrocutioner passive (500068), so Electrocute's own hit cannot grant a fresh buff and the aura reading after the cast isolates consumption.
